Changes.dc.html.title: What changed from the old app, and why

Apis.dc.html.title: Sync order, APIs used, APIs missing

n_decide.text:
DECISIONS FOR YOU (my default first)

1 · Schemes on phone orders: none, same as the VK Nex desktop/web Sales Order (schemes apply when the office bills it). Or apply them on the phone too?

2 · Sales bill (van sale) on the phone: keep it, only for salesmen whose VK Nex login has the Post right on Sales Bill. Or orders only?

3 · Printing: none on the phone, because VK Nex gives the bill number only at Sync. Or print/share a copy that carries the phone's ref no?

4 · Cash handover with expenses and note count: drawn on page F. Keep it (needs a new VK Nex route; Till already keeps note counts), or drop it and stop at Day close?

5 · Sales return: saved as a Draft, and the office posts it. That is VK Nex's approval gate.

6 · Items for the customer's type: filter the item list by VK Nex's item_cust_group / item_retail_item, with a chip to show all. Or always show all?

n_legend.text:
HOW TO READ
Each box is one phone screen, except step 12, which happens in VK Nex desktop or web. Open pages A–G for the screens. Every screen uses the same parts: a maroon header, white cards, chips, and one main button at the bottom.

Sample data throughout: Acme Foods (the VK Nex dev company) and the customer Sri Murugan Stores. The amounts add up with VK Nex's own formulas.

n_signin.text:
WAS: a salesman picker and an optional second salesman. A blank user with a blank password opened the app.

NOW: the salesman's own VK Nex login (Mobile login on). The first sign-in is online; after that it works offline against the saved login.

NEW API: the login answer must also give the salesman (employee id) and the company's GST state code.

n_sync.text:
WAS: Complete / Quick / Device sync, Upload receipts and close day, Remove old data, plus host, port and UUID on Settings.

NOW: one Sync now button. It sends in VK Nex order (customers → orders → bills → receipts → returns → visits), then receives. The server address is changed in Settings, which also has Download all again and Clear this phone. Each refusal is shown in plain words next to its record.

FIX: /mobile/receipts/options refuses a phone that is not registered.

n_today.text:
WAS: home was either the customer list or Area-wise outstanding.

NOW: one home: today's beat with dues and visit status. Outstanding = the VK Nex balance; Overdue = the open bills' daysOverdue.

Beat = VK Nex area (cusAreaId). Group = customer group (was 'Type').

n_filters.text:
WAS: three popups (status, beat, type) with different headings and no Select all.

NOW: one sheet with Status, Beat, Group and Dues, Select all / Clear, and a live count on the button.

n_menu.text:
WAS: Home (broken link), Switch company, Reports, Sync, Settings, Logout (closed the whole app).

NOW: Today, Dues, My documents, Day close, Reports, Sync, Company, Settings. Sign out goes back to Sign in.

n_customer.text:
WAS: Option.qml hub with outstanding only; Advance hidden; Check in as an action.

NOW: a credit panel with the web app's labels (Outstanding / Overdue / Credit limit / Available), plus the bill-count and credit-days lines that VK Nex checks on a bill. 'Check in' became 'No order': an order, bill or receipt already proves the visit.

Data: customers/get (limits) + receipts/open-bills (overdue).

n_noorder.text:
WAS: two check-ins (order, collection). Reasons in Tamil only, GPS never saved, and an apostrophe broke the save.

NOW: one screen with VK Nex's six reason codes. GPS is saved (cvLatitude / cvLongitude / cvGpsAccuracy).

BLOCKED today: visits wait for the salesman's employee id (cvSalesmanId).

n_custform.text:
WAS: Add customer and Update customer, both online, with different layouts.

NOW: one form with VK Nex customer fields and refusal rules, saved on the phone and sent at Sync. Credit terms are read-only: the office sets them.

NEW API: clientUuid on /mobile/customers/create, so a resend can't make a duplicate.

n_ledger.text:
WAS: needed internet, the date label was wrong, and dates took three screens.

NOW: the statement is downloaded at Sync (this FY + last FY), with range chips and one date picker.

n_items.text:
WAS: Order entry and Sales select items did the same job with different controls.

NOW: one Items screen for the Sales order and the Sales bill. Rate = customer's price level − customer rate (csrDiscQty), then the qty slab if lower, as in VK Nex.

NEW API: /mobile/items/list applies neither customer rates nor qty slabs today.

n_itemline.text:
WAS: two item-detail screens with different price-level and discount rules.

NOW: one line sheet with VK Nex line fields: Case Qty, Bill Qty, Net Qty, Rate, Disc %, GST %. Rate is typed only with the Edit price right; a rate below Min is refused, and one above MRP is refused unless skip-MRP is on.

A free item is its own line (soiIsFree), not a Free Qty box.

n_orderreview.text:
WAS: OrderCheckout, with no header and no confirmation, plus freight/cooly.

NOW: the VK Nex order header (Term, Delivery date, Priority, Delivery mode, Remarks). GST is CGST+SGST when the POS state = the company state, else IGST, rounded to paise per line.

Credit is warn-and-confirm, as on the desktop. No schemes on orders. Saved as a VK Nex DRAFT at Sync; the office confirms.

n_billreview.text:
WAS: SalesCheckout; the bill no restarted daily; the payment step was dead code.

NOW: CREDIT bill only (the mobile route). The godown is picked, and auto-apply schemes work as on the desktop bill. Credit uses sales.credit_limit_mode: REFUSE blocks, WARN needs the override right. VK Nex posts and numbers it (bil…) at Sync.

NEW API: schemes, settings, godown stock.

n_receipt.text:
WAS: company/group screens, a payment-types sheet, and an Advance receipt saved against a dummy bill '123'.

NOW: one screen with VK Nex tenders. VK Nex fills the oldest bills first, and the rest stays on account (this replaces Advance).

RISK: refused when accounts.receipt_salesman_mandatory is on (the mobile route has no salesman).

n_return.text:
WAS: four screens; the brand/group filter broke the list.

NOW: against a bill (VK Nex default), one reason from the VK Nex reason master, a godown, and return qty ≤ billed. VK Nex works out the money. It is saved as a DRAFT, and the office posts it (approval gate).

NEW API: /mobile/returns + reasons + bill lines.

n_dayclose.text:
WAS: 8 reports (sales, tender, order and group summaries) plus Sync receipts with expense, net cash and a note count.

NOW: one summary from the phone's own records (Today / This week / This month, by payment type and item group). Next comes Cash handover and Note count on page F, then Sync.

n_myorders.text:
WAS: Sales list, Bill detail, Order list, Order detail, Receipt list, Return list (the phone's own data; Bill detail's delete put stock back on the wrong bill).

NOW: My documents with Orders, Bills, Receipts, Returns. Edit or delete only before Sync; after Sync it shows the VK Nex status (Draft · Confirmed · Partly billed · Completed · Cancelled for orders).

NEW API: /mobile/orders/list. No route lets a phone read orders.

n_dues.text:
WAS: page 7 · Collection mode: Area-wise outstanding (a second home), Party-wise outstanding and a Bill search popup that pasted typed text into SQL.

NOW: one Dues screen: beat totals, shops sorted by oldest bill, search by shop or bill no; tap a shop to open Receipt. Collection salesmen can start here (Menu › Dues).

Data: customers list + receipts/open-bills, both downloaded today.

n_msgs.text:
WAS: page 8 · Messages: one Server error popup for every failure (even refusals), system "Warning !!!" dialogs, stacked notices, and a message bar that never closed.

NOW: four kinds only. 1 A dialog when the salesman must decide (wording from VK Nex desktop). 2 Sync banners that say network or refusal, with VK Nex's reason. 3 Errors under the field. 4 A saved notice that goes away by itself.

n_reports.text:
WAS: page 10 · Reports: 13 screens of the phone's own data. Most had no date filter, totals were all-time, and several had bugs (Bill detail put stock back on bill 1; Stock summary over-counted).

NOW: one Reports list with one date strip (Today / This week / This month / dates). Each report opens the screen that already holds its data: Day close (summaries), My documents (lists), Dues, Ledger, Stock.

GST, registers and stock valuation stay in VK Nex desktop and web.

n_settings.text:
WAS: page 9 · Settings: server, display, login, syncing, sales, receipt, search, printing, Bluetooth, godown and company, all phone switches (some hidden but still saved).

NOW: only what belongs to the phone: server and device, phone data, language and text size, start screen, item filter (decision 6), print or share (decision 3). Sales and receipt rules show read-only, as VK Nex sets them (new mobile/settings route).

Dropped: multi-user login, background quick sync, godown (picked per bill), company (from login).

n_syncprog.text:
WAS: one bar ("Complete sync running 7 of 20") and steps 1 and 3 shown twice; Quick sync also reloaded every item.

NOW: the steps in VK Nex order, sending first, then receiving, with counts. Stop after this step is safe: every upload is resend-safe, so a dropped Wi-Fi never sends anything twice.

n_handover.text:
WAS: Sync receipts (ReceiptApprovalPopup): total receipts, "EXPESNE", net cash and a note count, blocked until sales were uploaded. After the upload every receipt was marked sent, even ones saved meanwhile.

NOW: Day close → Cash handover: receipts by payment type (UPI and cheques kept apart), expenses, net cash, note count, then Sync. Receipts themselves are already posted one by one at Sync.

DECISION 4 + NEW API: VK Nex has no phone route for the handover or expenses.

n_notecount.text:
WAS: Denom_test.qml (the real Denom.qml was unreachable), Save only, no Cancel, and ₹2000 notes that are withdrawn.

NOW: ₹500 to ₹10 plus coins, a live total against the net cash, Cancel and Save. A mismatch shows in red but can still be saved with a note.
